description: Groups a shared context and an ordered list of independent questions.

examples.label: Example 1
examples.code:
Title
A day at the museum
Context
The museum opens at 9 a.m. Admission costs 8 euros.
Questions
  1. Title
    Opening time
    Prompt
    When does the museum open?
    Form
    Feedback
    Compare your answer with the opening time in the context.
    Solution
    At 9 a.m.
  2. Title
    Admission
    Prompt
    How much do two tickets cost?
    Form
    Feedback
    Multiply the price of one ticket by two.
    Solution
    16 euros.

attributes.description: Optional nonzero time limit in strict hh:mm:ss format.

userHelp.introduction: The custom `<tp-exercise>` element groups a shared context and an ordered list of questions, with an optional countdown for the whole activity.
userHelp.interactions:
#### Mouse interactions

| Control or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Exercise title | Expand or collapse the context and questions. |
| Start | Reveal the context and questions and begin the shared countdown. |
| Continue | Reveal the context and questions after expiry, preserving answers. |

Question controls belong to each question and have their own User help.

#### Keyboard interactions

| Key or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>Tab</kbd> / <kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>Tab</kbd> | Move between available controls. |
| <kbd>Enter</kbd> / <kbd>Space</kbd> | Expand or collapse the focused summary, or activate the focused Start or Continue button. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Open User help for the component under the pointer, falling back to the focused component. <kbd>Shift</kbd> may be needed to type ?. |
